relation: Finite supplied-family incidence regularity: hg_regular E d holds when every vertex v of the finite carrier lies in exactly d members of the supplied family E : {set {set T}}, counted by A10 incidence_degree E v. Arbitrary carrier and family, E before d, universal equality; no uniformity, positivity, inhabited-carrier, nonempty-edge, covering or attained-degree premise (an empty carrier is regular of every degree; empty members never count). Simple-graph, multigraph, directed and infinite (ordinal neighbour enumeration, D4inf3) regularity are separate.

Infinite.conjectures.D4inf3.regular is a deferred distinct class of the same owner.
